description.value: Day To Day Grocery & Produce is a South Asian wholesale cash-and-carry grocery chain operating under Guruji Foods Inc., founded in 2020. It specializes in South Asian staples — premium basmati rice, Ayurvedic herbs, exotic spices, fresh fruits and vegetables — stocking over 5,000 products across its BC locations. The chain positions itself as one of the largest South Asian grocery stores in the Lower Mainland, with locations in Surrey, Delta, Langley, Abbotsford, Victoria, and Kamloops.
